description: Renders (or serves cached) a downsized preview and returns it as an image content block. Non-blocking; returns pending if generation takes too long.

maxDim.description: Longest-edge cap in px. Hard max 1024.

params.description: Same query string as get_rendered_asset_url (e.g. pos=face&mimi=...). mimi_mode and upscale are stripped for the preview (previews always render the standard tier).

timeoutMs.description: Max time to block waiting for cold render

name: render_asset_preview
